annotations.title: Who holds this job here: how many, and at what pay?

description: Use when the user is sizing a B2B buyer persona or a hiring market: "how many marketing managers are in Houston?", "how many accountants work in Texas and what do they earn?". Returns employment, mean and median annual wage, jobs per 1,000, and the location quotient against the nation, from BLS OEWS. Wage-and-salary jobs only. Refuses before you are charged if BLS suppresses the estimate or the series do not line up. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (latest May OEWS); place: state or cbsa; segment: soc (occupation). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For how many businesses employ them, use run_business_universe.

cbsa.description: Five-digit metro area code, e.g. 26420 for Houston.

soc.description: Six-digit SOC occupation code, e.g. 11-2021 (marketing managers).

state.description: Two-letter US state code, or US.
